title: Six Feet Under
content: Occasionally (particularly when a Buzzwords column is due), I search Google News for articles reporting on new and interesting entomological research, but I’ve noticed over the years that most of the news stories about insects that I find aren’t about cutting-edge scientific research at all. That was the case on 21 December 2024, when a headline caught my eye: “Japanese Chemical Company Holds Memorial for Murdered Bugs” (Allen 2024). Of course, I reflexively clicked on the link and thereby discovered a story about Earth Corporation of Japan, a chemical company specializing in “Manufacturing, marketing, and import/export of pharmaceutical products, quasi-drugs, medical tools, household products, etc.” Among the “etc.” are a goodly number of Earth Corporation products designed to cause death and destruction across the Phylum Arthropoda (and beyond). Such substances require safety and efficacy tests before they can be sold to the public, and it was likely during these tests when countless numbers of insects gave up their lives for the benefit of Earth Corporation shareholders.
